author: Islam Ibrahim - Carrots Team
name: Pixel3DDither
shortDescription: Low-resolution pixel-art and cartoon post-processing for GDevelop 3D: palette mapping, OKLab cel shading, Bayer dither, depth + crease outlines, vignette and chromatic aberration — as a proper per-layer composer pass.
description: Pixel 3D 5.0 is a rebuild of Pixel3DDither for the real GDevelop renderer.
- No more threeRenderer.render monkey-patch. The effect is a normal EffectComposer pass on the selected 3D layer, so it works with FSR1, LOD3D, light3d, MSAA, SMAA, bloom, AO and the layer 2D plane.
- The pass is inserted after the engine OutputPass. Tone mapping, exposure and sRGB conversion from light3d/the engine are respected; there is no manualGamma or shadowLift patch.
- The composer is resized to an integer pixel grid with a correct setSize patch, so the GPU shades one fragment per pixel and LOD3D reads the real internal height.
- Depth comes from the engine SceneDepthRenderPass. Outlines use inverse-depth Laplacian (silhouettes) and depth-derived normals (interior creases), not only the silhouette.

- Colors are processed in linear/OKLab, then converted back to sRGB. Quantization preserves hue, palette mapping dithers between the two nearest palette colors with a Bayer threshold, and premultiplied alpha is preserved.
- The old texture traversal/fixTextures, forced anisotropy, supersample cost and global renderer hook are gone.
- WebGPU is guarded, every layer has its own state, and onSceneUnloading restores the composer, OutputPass blending, depth request and ordering.

Presets: Pixel Art (360p grid, 24 colors, outline), Cartoon (full res, OKLab cel bands, rim, outline), Game Boy (288p, 4-color green palette), CGA (240p, 16-color CGA palette), Hi-Res Pixel (540p, 32 colors). Palettes: PICO-8, Game Boy, Sweetie 16, CGA, NES and custom.

Usage: create a 3D layer, call "Enable Pixel 3D on a layer" once at the start of the scene, keep the UI on a separate 2D layer. For FSR1 + Pixel together use the patched FSR1 in the integration folder: it skips layers where Pixel 3D is active.

eventsFunctions.description: Installs the Pixel 3D pass on a 3D layer. The pass runs after the engine OutputPass (tone mapping + sRGB), resizes the composer to an integer pixel grid, and adds palette/cel shading, dithering, outlines and optional vignette/chromatic aberration. FSR1 on the same layer is disabled automatically.
